provenance.observation: UPOS only for any model observation; oracle case labels are sender-side fitting inputs, recorded per token with label_source
provenance.split: document-index stride over authenticated # newdoc id values (dev), cross-validated against vendor/ud_ewt_case_counts.json
provenance.document_identity_source: # newdoc id comments from the authenticated CoNLL-U source
provenance.label_source: ailm.corpus.ud.case_oracle_assignment unchanged: feats[Case] morphology first, then deprel, then the token-level adposition route; derived labels are agreement, not accuracy
